summary: End-to-end validation of the new Industry Templates / AI-generated Operating System feature. Backend (14 pytest cases across generation, register-with-blueprint, PATCH edits, legacy owner) and Frontend (full onboarding flow + CompanyDialog OS editing + persistence) both PASSED completely. AI generation for Manufacturing produced 8 departments, 12 workflows, 15 operational tasks and 8 approval rules; all became editable in the UI and were correctly persisted to the tenant.

tests_executed.case: POST /api/onboarding/os-blueprint returns departments/workflows/operational_tasks/approval_rules with correct shape and content caps
Department items have {key,label} and no 'owner'; workflow items have name; op-task items have title+category; rule items have name
POST /api/auth/register with os_blueprint returns os_summary with counts matching blueprint
Departments from blueprint become tenant.roles (implicit owner excluded)
tenant.workflow_templates / operational_task_templates / approval_rules are all persisted
Register with duplicate email returns 400
PATCH /api/tenant/os-blueprint adds workflow and persists (verified via /auth/me GET)
PATCH /api/tenant/os-blueprint updates approval_rules only
PATCH /api/tenant/os-blueprint updates operational_task_templates only
Legacy owner@sharma.com (tenant with no blueprint) can still PATCH os-blueprint successfully
Onboarding Step 1: fill company/name/email/password + select Industry=Manufacturing, click Next
Onboarding Step 2 & 3: click Next; Step 3 triggers AI generation (suggest-loading visible)
Onboarding Step 4: OS editor loads with 8 role-chips, 12 workflow-chips, 15 optask-rows, 8 rule-rows (all AI-generated for Manufacturing)
Add a workflow via workflow-input + add-workflow-button - chip appears (12 -> 13)
Remove an optask via remove-optask-<i> - row disappears (15 -> 14)
Click 'Provision Operating System' shows onboarding-os-ready with title 'Your Manufacturing Operating System is Ready.'
os-summary shows 4 count cards (8 Departments / 13 Workflows / 14 Operational / 8 Approval)
Continue advances to Step 5, Skip -> Step 6, Skip -> Step 7, Enter DecisionOS lands at dashboard authenticated
Company profile button opens CompanyDialog with os-blueprint-section
CompanyDialog OS lists (os-workflows-list/os-optasks-list/os-rules-list) show exact same counts as onboarding state (13/14/8)
Add workflow via os-workflow-add + os-workflow-name-<i>, click os-save-button, reopen dialog -> 'TEST_CompanyDialogAddedWF' persists (14th workflow)

roles-manage-list contains all 8 AI-generated departments (Production & Assembly, QA & Control, Supply Chain & Procurement, Engineering & Product Development, Sales & Customer Relations, Finance & Cost Accounting, Maintenance & Facilities, HS&E)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4065 lines - continues to grow. Recommend extracting onboarding endpoints (os-blueprint gen, register, tenant/os-blueprint PATCH) into a dedicated /app/backend/routers/onboarding.py to improve maintainability. Same recommendation applies to invites/roles/tenant which currently live alongside a very large file.

normalize_os_blueprint caps departments at 12 but the frontend UI relies on the same list becoming roles - consider surfacing a soft warning if the AI returns > cap so the user knows why some departments were dropped. Not blocking today because the LLM stays within limits, but a silent truncation could confuse users on re-generation.

PATCH /api/tenant/os-blueprint stores workflow_templates as [{name}] and drops any other keys - fine, but CompanyDialog's payload should be documented in the OSBlueprintInput model so that future contributors don't add fields that get silently dropped.

os-save-button success toast could not be verified positively in the automated test - the mutation clearly works (persistence confirmed after reopen) but the success toast text was not present in body.innerText at the check moment. Consider adding a role='status' data-testid on the sonner toast (e.g. data-testid='toast-success') so tests can assert it deterministically.

Login.js is at ~791 lines and Step 4 alone owns >150 lines of JSX. Consider extracting the OS editor block and the Ready summary into /pages/onboarding/OsEditor.js and /pages/onboarding/OsReady.js for readability.

Frontend uses same testid 'toggle-auth-mode' for two different buttons (line 456 login->register and line 782 register->login). It works because only one is rendered at a time, but it's fragile - consider distinct testids like 'go-to-register' and 'back-to-login'.
test_credentials: owner@sharma.com / demo1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) used only for the legacy-owner PATCH test. Full onboarding used a fresh unique email qatest+os<timestamp>@example.com.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed tenants via registration (email qatest+os<ts>@example.com; company TEST_OS_<ts>). Each has an OS blueprint with 1 extra workflow ('TEST_new_workflow' or 'TEST_Dispatch'/'TEST_CompanyDialogAddedWF'). Legacy owner@sharma.com now has a single 'TEST_legacy_wf' workflow appended to its (previously empty) workflow_templates. Safe to leave; can be cleaned by deleting tenants with company_name LIKE 'TEST_OS_%' and stripping TEST_ workflows from Sharma.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 44 fully validated the Industry Templates feature. Full flow works end-to-end: AI generation on Step 3->4 (~5-8s for Manufacturing), edits reflect immediately, Provision returns os_summary counts, Ready screen renders correctly with counts, onboarding advances to Step 5/6/7 unchanged, CompanyDialog exposes os-blueprint-section with os-workflows-list/os-optasks-list/os-rules-list and Save persists via PATCH /api/tenant/os-blueprint. Team Roles (roles-manage-list) automatically populated from departments. Legacy tenants without a blueprint can still add via CompanyDialog. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration44_os_blueprint.py is stable regression coverage.
